_comment: S-Class (signalling-state) decode config. STRICTLY ADDITIVE to the C-Class TD path — these areas/types are decoded in ADDITION to the existing LA CA/CB/CC capture, never replacing it. Bits use SOP-style byte:bit numbering with bit 0 = LSB (so bit 7 = 0x80). Sources: user-contributed BM map (July 2024) + Open Rail Data wiki. Add more areas/crossings here as they are confirmed — describer->byte:bit->crossing mappings live ONLY in config, never in code.

BM.name: Barnham
BM._logRaw_note: 'all' = log every S-Class message for this area (lets us re-derive and hunt for L() functions not yet in the map). 'watched' = log only messages touching a watched byte (lower volume). Decoded barrier events are logged regardless.

YN.name: Yapton
YN._note: YN=Yapton is the only L() in the July-2024 BM map; the byte09<->Yapton physical binding is confirmed by berth-step correlation in Phase 1 capture.
